name: Fairmont Baku Flame Towers
positioning: Fairmont Baku, Flame Towers: a high-rise city hotel overlooking Baku's medieval Old City and the Caspian Sea
best_for: Travelers who want Caspian Sea and city views from a high-floor room or suite
Guests who want a spa with a hammam, saunas and a rooftop pool

facts.text: The hotel is located at the Flame Towers, overlooking the medieval Old City and the Caspian Sea.
The hotel's address is Flame Towers, 1A Mehdi Huseyn, Baku, Azerbaijan.
The hotel has a spa with a hammam, saunas and a rooftop pool.
The hotel's spa is called Carol Joy Spa.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Caspian Sea or the city.
The Caspian Suite is on the 22nd and 28th floors and has double-height windows at the tip of the Flame Tower.
Fairmont Gold Signature Suites are on high floors, at the corner of the Flame Towers building, in a uniquely shaped room.
The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms and is on the 24th and 25th floors, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience at the hotel.
Fairmont Gold includes complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes.
Fairmont Gold includes private lounge access.
